
# isarray

`Array#isArray` for older browsers and deprecated Node.js versions.

[![build status](https://example.invalid/juliangruber/isarray.svg)](http://example.invalid/juliangruber/isarray)
[![downloads](https://example.invalid/npm/dm/isarray.svg)](https://example.invalid/package/isarray)

[![browser support](https://example.invalid/juliangruber/isarray.png)
](https://example.invalid/juliangruber/isarray)

__Just use Array.isArray directly__, unless you need to support those older versions.

## Usage

```js
var isArray = require('isarray');

console.log(isArray([])); // => true
console.log(isArray({})); // => false
```

## Installation

With [npm](https://example.invalid) do

```bash
$ npm install isarray
```

Then bundle for the browser with
[browserify](https://example.invalid/substack/node-browserify).
